boundary.description: From the Smithy Bridge Railway Station, SW along the railway to the point it crosses Newbold railway branch. Then N by a bee-line to River Roch and W along it to South Parade. Then W to the roundabout and by a bee-line N to Spotland Road (A680) and its junction with Mount Street. Then by a bee-line S to the junction of Norman Road and Mellor Street. W and then N along Mellor Street and River Spodden to the Rochdale – Rossendale boundary and along that boundary to the point near Brownhouse Wham Reservoir, then continuing by a bee-line E to the junction of Ramsden Road and Birch Road to its junction with Thimble Close. Then E by a bee-line to Union Road, Halifax Road, New Road and Smithy Bridge Road to the Smithy Bridge Railway Station.
